QGIS Project Export

Source: R/qgis_export.R
qgis_export.Rd

Package a sampling plan (output of the GRTS + TSP workflow, see tutorial 09-sampling) as a .qgz QGIS 3.x project that can be opened directly in QGIS Desktop or pushed to QField on a tablet via the QFieldSync plugin.

A .qgz is a ZIP archive containing a QGIS project file (.qgs XML) and the data referenced with relative paths. We embed a GeoPackage with the layers required for field work:

  • placettes: GRTS sampling points (editable metadata).

  • arbres: empty layer seeded from get_arbre_schema, filled on the field.

  • zone_etude: study area (read-only context).

  • parcours_tsp (optional): TSP route between plots.

The QGIS project file declares edit widgets, aliases, and NOT NULL constraints based on the schemas returned by get_placette_schema and get_arbre_schema, so the form is ready to use both on QGIS Desktop and on QField.

Developed by Pascal Obstétar.
